title: Transcatheter Aortic Valve Replacement (TAVR)

change_log.author: CarePolicyGuard Regulatory Informatics
change_log.summary: Statutory citation mapping against CMS Pub 100-03 Manual Section 20.33.

description: CMS coverage for TAVR in patients with severe symptomatic native aortic stenosis. Requires documented AVA <= 1.0 cm2 or mean gradient >= 40 mmHg, NYHA functional Class >= II, formal multidisciplinary Heart Team consultation, and absence of procedural futility or prohibitive surgical/anatomical contraindications.
scope_note: Curated benchmark criterion schema targeting primary statutory indications, exclusions, and waiting periods; not an exhaustive legal transcription of full multi-page CMS coverage manuals.

criteria.name: Severe Aortic Stenosis Hemodynamic Threshold
criteria.description: Aortic valve area (AVA) <= 1.0 cm2 or mean aortic gradient >= 40 mmHg or peak velocity >= 4.0 m/s on echocardiography.
criteria.clinical_intent: Confirm statutory hemodynamic threshold for severe AS
criteria.source_text_excerpt: Patients with severe symptomatic aortic stenosis (AVA <= 1.0 cm2 or mean aortic gradient >= 40 mmHg or peak velocity >= 4.0 m/s).

criteria.name: Heart Team Consultation
criteria.description: Documented formal multidisciplinary Heart Team collaborative consultation involving cardiac surgeon and interventional cardiologist.
criteria.source_text_excerpt: A multidisciplinary team (heart team) that includes a cardiac surgeon and an interventional cardiologist who have independently evaluated the patient.

criteria.name: Procedural Futility Exclusion
criteria.description: TAVR is excluded when intervention is futile due to active infective endocarditis, metastatic malignancy, hospice care, or severe non-cardiac comorbidity with life expectancy < 1 year.
criteria.clinical_intent: Exclude non-beneficial device placement under futile clinical conditions
criteria.source_text_excerpt: TAVR is non-covered when procedural futility exists due to severe non-cardiac conditions with life expectancy < 1 year or terminal comorbid illness.

criteria.name: Prohibitive Surgical or Anatomical Contraindication Exclusion
criteria.description: TAVR is excluded when the patient has prohibitive anatomical barriers or prohibitive procedural contraindications (e.g. prohibitive aortic root anatomy, active uncontrolled sepsis/bacteremia, or severe uncorrectable bleeding diathesis).
criteria.clinical_intent: Exclude patients with prohibitive anatomical or procedural contraindications
criteria.source_paragraph: Paragraph 2: Prohibitive Surgical and Anatomical Contraindications
criteria.source_text_excerpt: TAVR is non-covered for patients with prohibitive anatomical contraindications or uncontrolled systemic sepsis.
